summary.intent: Plan and execute Phase 45 of the cipher-box project — a Rust-only hygiene refactor of the FUSE write-journal/replay code (7 scope items, no behavior change) — using the GSD workflow orchestrator.
summary.outcome: Planning completed fully (6 plans across 5 waves, research/validation/patterns committed, verification passed). Execution reached Wave 3 (plan 45-04 spawned) with Waves 1–2 confirmed complete and 3/6 plans done; transcript cuts off before Wave 3 result.

repo: The FUSE crate is named `cipherbox-fuse` (default feature `fuse`); located at `crates/fuse/`.
The workspace spans `crates/fuse`, `cipherbox-sdk`, and `apps/desktop/src-tauri` — all must be checked when changing shared SDK types like `JournalOp`.
The GSD Rust API surface extractor is regex-based and does not support Rust; it returns 0 symbols and should be skipped for Rust-only phases.
The GSD commit helper has a known false-negative bug: it returns `commit_failed` even when `lint-staged` and `git commit` succeed. Always verify with `git log`.
`fuse/windows/mod.rs` is `cfg`-excluded on macOS, causing rust-analyzer 'unlinked-file' diagnostics that are not real errors.
Vendored `fuser` ABI file (`fuse_abi.rs`) carries pre-existing dead-code warnings unrelated to phase work.
Only Wave 1 (45-01, 45-02) has true parallelism; Waves 2–5 all serialize through `crates/fuse/src/lib.rs`, making worktree parallelization high-risk for negligible benefit.
Phase branch is `feat/desktop-fuse-write-durability-cleanup`; `auto_advance: true` is set in `.planning/config.json`.

code.finding: Type mismatch site after `file_meta_ipns_name` was changed to `Option<String>` in plan 45-03; IDE showed E0308 but this resolved to a stale rust-analyzer cache — `cargo check --workspace` exited 0.
String-vs-Option comparison flagged by IDE after 45-03; confirmed stale diagnostic, not a real compile error.

workflow: After an executor claims tests pass, always run `cargo check --workspace` (not just the single crate) to catch downstream consumer breakage from type changes.
IDE rust-analyzer diagnostics can show stale errors captured mid-edit during a subagent run; treat `cargo check` exit code as ground truth.
Sequential execution on the feature branch (USE_WORKTREES=false) is the correct default when only the first wave is parallelizable — worktree overhead isn't justified.
The GSD post-research gate sequence is: VALIDATION.md → security gate banner → pattern-mapper (PATTERNS.md) → planner → checker; all artifacts should be committed before spawning the planner.
Non-blocking verification warnings (RESEARCH.md open-questions heading, VALIDATION.md template placeholders) should be cleaned immediately after the checker runs to avoid accumulation.

friction: GSD commit helper returned `commit_failed` false-negative after VALIDATION.md commit, requiring a manual `git log` check to confirm the commit landed (`340e93efe`).
Rust API surface extractor returned 0 symbols for a Rust project — no error surfaced, just silently empty output that had to be recognized and skipped.

IDE diagnostics after plan 45-03 showed E0308 type errors in `read_ops.rs:821` and `macros.rs`, forcing a manual `cargo check --workspace` round-trip to confirm they were stale rust-analyzer cache artifacts.
rust-analyzer emits 'unlinked-file' warnings for `fuse/windows/mod.rs` on macOS due to `cfg` exclusion — visually noisy but harmless.

Waves 4 and 5 (plans 45-05, 45-06) not yet executed: reuse `publish_file_metadata`/memoize `resolve_folder_key` and consolidate fuser/winfsp journal builders into `journal_helpers.rs`.
Phase verification and STATE/ROADMAP completion update only happen after all 6 plans are done — blocked on Wave 3–5 completion.
